comparison_markers: ## Upstream Delta Since the Previous Pin

delta_decisions.upstream_change: shared-brain watcher guidance wakes on addressed replies while keeping announcements silent, with separate watcher and inbox cursor handling
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no agent logstream, watcher cursor, inbox cursor, notification wake filter, or replication owner. Its local filesystem watcher does not consume upstream coordination events.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: repair and MCP status distinguish a missing Chroma SQLite integrity verdict from a clean quick_check result
delta_decisions.rationale: The current package is LanceDB-only and has no Chroma chroma.sqlite3 integrity gate, SQLite quick_check verdict, or HTTP MCP status owner. Lance health and recovery use a separate storage contract.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: CONTRIBUTING documents upstream's branch naming and pull-request target model
delta_decisions.rationale: This is upstream repository-process documentation. The fork retains its own Git workflow in AGENTS.md and gains no runtime or release capability from the upstream wording.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: the sqlite_exact backend invalidates caches across handles and applies filtered ID lookups consistently
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork ships LanceDB only and has no sqlite_exact backend, cross-handle sqlite_exact cache, or filtered sqlite_exact ID lookup surface.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: search widens and hydrates closet-enriched candidates, then removes duplicate rendered passages while preserving plain-drawer repeats
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork's code_search operates on Lance chunks and does not implement upstream closet enrichment, parent-drawer hydration, or the generic search result shape changed by this group.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: palace graph statistics include general rooms, room instances, passive and explicit tunnels, and total connections
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already derives graph statistics from all Lance room metadata, reports rooms, tunnel rooms, edges, rooms per wing, and top tunnels, and verifies exact counts plus the empty-store boundary.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: CLI and MCP surfaces render canonical shared-brain coordination rules
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no shared-brain rules owner, distributed coordination protocol, live hub, or peer-fleet contract. Adding a rules command would advertise an unsupported capability.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: MCP drawer update and delete purge stale closet entries associated with the mutated drawer
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork stores and mutates Lance drawers directly and has no upstream closet index or closet-enrichment cache to purge. Lance stale-fragment cleanup owns storage versions, a different lifecycle.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: generic MCP search exposes candidate union and retains lexical candidates under strict vector thresholds only when stored embeddings satisfy the threshold
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork's documented hybrid code_search reranks one over-fetched Lance vector pool and exposes no generic candidate_strategy=union contract. Importing upstream union logic would create a second retrieval behavior owner.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: project mempalace.yaml reads and writes use UTF-8 explicitly on every platform
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork already reads project YAML through read_regular_text(..., encoding="utf-8") and writes generated mempalace.yaml through an explicit UTF-8 atomic destination writer.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: task create, list, read, inbox, and complete flows are coordinated through logstream-aware skills and Claude/Cursor plugin packaging, with controlled launch-input validation
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no upstream task state owner, task CLI/MCP tools, logstream notification workflow, Claude marketplace task skill, or Cursor task plugin surface. Its portable Agent Plugin keeps the existing four-tool default.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: upstream init persists its constructor or environment-resolved palace_path instead of the module default
delta_decisions.rationale: The upstream constructor-level palace override and init lifecycle are not the fork's project-init contract. The fork's --palace selection is command-scoped and this review does not import upstream global-config persistence semantics.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: the Qdrant backend sends a versioned MemPalace user-agent and tests the request header
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no supported Qdrant backend or outbound Qdrant client, so it has no matching request-header owner.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: the project miner recognizes C and C++ source and header suffixes as readable inputs
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork's canonical language catalog already maps and scans .c, .h, .cpp, and .hpp as readable C/C++ sources and keeps readable extensions synchronized with detection metadata.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: configuration setters refuse to overwrite a config file that could not be read and preserve malformed bytes before publishing replacement configuration
delta_decisions.rationale: The applicable reproduced data-loss class is closed locally by CONFIG-PEOPLE-MAP-MALFORMED-PRESERVE: save_people_map refuses malformed or unreadable existing people_map.json, preserves the original bytes, and gives bounded repair-and-retry guidance.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: upstream MCP mine accepts one conversation file when mode=convos and aligns its tool documentation with that input shape
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork's MCP mempalace_mine owns initialized project-directory mining and explicitly rejects a file path; conversation ingestion remains a separate directory-oriented CLI/module surface. No upstream hub or hook-transcript contract is advertised.
